## Selected production work

- **Dealerware (May 2022–April 2026)**: Worked on distributed systems processing approximately 10,000 telematics events per minute; authored 40+ ADRs/RFCs; contributed 370+ merged pull requests across 20+ production repositories; and led a zero-downtime Elasticsearch-to-OpenSearch migration that materially reduced infrastructure cost while preserving production availability.
- **Nebula Ideas (2010–Present)**: Advise startups and product teams on architecture, backend modernization, AI adoption, technical strategy, and product development while remaining hands-on with implementation.

## Open Source Projects

### ruby-skill-bench
- **URL**: https://ismaelmarin.dev/ruby-skill-bench/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/igmarin/ruby-skill-bench
- **RubyGems**: https://rubygems.org/gems/ruby-skill-bench
- **Description**: Evaluation framework for measuring whether engineering skills and additional context improve AI-agent performance using isolated runs, baseline-versus-context comparison, and blind judging. RubyGems recorded more than 3,000 total downloads as of 2026-09-25 UTC.

### rails-ai-bridge
- **URL**: https://ismaelmarin.dev/rails-ai-bridge-site/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/igmarin/rails-ai-bridge
- **RubyGems**: https://rubygems.org/gems/rails-ai-bridge
- **Description**: MCP and context infrastructure that lets AI coding assistants understand real Rails applications through generated project context and read-only introspection. RubyGems recorded more than 10,000 total downloads as of 2026-09-25 UTC.

### rails-agent-skills
- **URL**: https://ismaelmarin.dev/rails-agent-skills-site/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/igmarin/rails-agent-skills
- **Description**: Curated AI agent skill library for Ruby on Rails development. 43 executable skills and 9 workflows teaching AI coding tools how to plan, test, implement, document, and review Rails work using production-minded conventions. Tests gate implementation.

### agent-mcp-runtime
- **URL**: https://ismaelmarin.dev/agent-mcp-runtime-site/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/igmarin/agent-mcp-runtime
- **Description**: Safe Rust CLI for Model Context Protocol (MCP) runtime management. Orchestrates communication between LLMs and external tools using the ReAct reasoning pattern.

### ruby-core-skills
- **URL**: https://ismaelmarin.dev/ruby-core-skills-site/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/igmarin/ruby-core-skills
- **Description**: Core Ruby skills for AI agent evaluation. A structured library of language fundamentals and idiomatic patterns that AI agents are tested against.

### hanakai-yaku
- **URL**: https://ismaelmarin.dev/hanakai-yaku-site/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/igmarin/hanakai-yaku
- **Description**: Curated library of atomic development skills and orchestrated agents for AI coding assistants, enforcing TDD and DDD discipline for Hanami 2.x Ruby applications.

### agnostic-planning-skills
- **URL**: https://ismaelmarin.dev/agnostic-planning-skills-site/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/igmarin/agnostic-planning-skills
- **Description**: Framework-agnostic AI planning capabilities. Enforces PM and software engineering planning discipline with structured templates for PRDs and task estimation.
